derivation: from H2114 (זוּר) (in the sense of estrangement) (compare H2219 (זָרָה));

occurrences.text: But even a whole month, until it come out at your nostrils, and it be loathsome unto you: because that ye have despised the Lord which is among you, and have wept before him, saying, Why came we forth out of Egypt?
